name: Spam Correcter
description: Detects fast alternating Jump input, then automates configurable press and release intervals until the player stops alternating.

hold-interval.name: Hold Interval (ms)
hold-interval.description: How many milliseconds the mod keeps Jump pressed during spam correction. Enter any whole number from 1 to 60000.

release-interval.name: Release Interval (ms)
release-interval.description: How many milliseconds the mod keeps Jump released during spam correction. Enter any whole number from 1 to 60000.
